name: 86 EIGHTY-SIX
description: Called “Juggernaut,” these are the unmanned combat drones developed by the Republic of San Magnolia in answer to the attacks by the autonomous unmanned drones of the neighboring Empire of Giad, the “Legion”. But they’re only unmanned in name. In reality, they are piloted by the Eighty-sixers—those considered to be less than human and treated as mere tools. Determined to achieve his own mysterious ends, Shin, the captain of Spearhead Squadron, which is comprised of Eighty-sixers, continues to fight a hopeless war on a battlefield where only death awaits him.

videos.title: The Poppies Bloom Red on the Battlefield
videos.overview: Season 1, episodes 01-11 recap. In this recap episode, Lena reflects on the events of the past months, and how she came to meet the men and women of Spearhead.

videos.title: Visual Commentary Special Episode
videos.overview: It's time for a special recap episode, as the voice actors walk us through their favorite scenes in the second season.

videos.title: If There's Something Worth Dying For
videos.overview: Season 1, episodes 12-18 recap. Take a look back at what's come before, as the former members of Spearhead get ready for their most deadly mission yet.

videos.title: At Least as a Human
videos.overview: Season 1, episodes 18-21 recap.

videos.title: Undertaker
videos.overview: The Republic of San Magnolia fights a safe humane war using drones. In reality, however, the drones are piloted by humans called 86s, who are called “pigs” and considered less than human.

videos.title: Spearhead
videos.overview: As Lena lives a life of safety and comfort inside the walls of her city, the 86ers fight a terrible battle against an unstoppable and inhuman enemy.

videos.title: I Don't Want to Die
videos.overview: Lena finds herself growing closer to the Spearhead squadron, or so she thinks. But a deadly battle drastically changes her perspective.

videos.title: Real Name
videos.overview: After a brutal death, Lena comes to terms with her real status as an Alba, and what it means to force another to fight for your sake.

videos.title: I'm With You
videos.overview: Lena learns the truth about the upcoming end of the war, and how the Legion is a much more deadly threat than she thought.

videos.title: Through to the End
videos.overview: Spearhead enjoys a brief respite near the cherry blossoms outside the wall, but a deadly attack brings the dangers of war even closer to home.

videos.title: Will You Remember Me?
videos.overview: As the day of the festival arrives, Lena and Shin watch the fireworks and enjoy a brief respite from their battles.

videos.title: Let's Go
videos.overview: Spearhead is given orders to undertake a pointless march into enemy territory, and not to stop until they're dead. Lena tries her best to stop this suicide mission from happening.

videos.title: Goodbye
videos.overview: Shin confronts his brother deep within Legion held territory. But even if he wins, there's no going back.

videos.title: Thank You
videos.overview: The crew of Spearhead has left on their final mission, never to return home. What awaits them outside the borders of their home?

videos.title: Here We Go
videos.overview: Spearhead Squadron comes to the end of their long road, and a new journey begins for Lena...

videos.title: Welcome
videos.overview: Spearhead awakens to find themselves in a strange new land, while Lena continues her battles as a Handler.

videos.title: It's Too Late
videos.overview: The members of Spearhead are given a brief respite from the war. But is it alright for them to enjoy themselves when so many have fallen?

videos.title: Glad to Be Here
videos.overview: The crew of Spearhead find themselves back on the battlefield, as the tide of the war turns against the Federacy.

videos.title: Welcome Back
videos.overview: The members of Spearhead are reunited as a massive Legion offensive looms. With the next deadly phase of the war almost here, how will they spend their remaining hours?

videos.title: Even So
videos.overview: The Legion's large-scale offensive begins, and the Spearhead crew are sent into the thick of the fighting. But even back at base, there's no safety to be found...

videos.title: I Won't Forget
videos.overview: As the war with the Legion rages on, the enemy makes a final march towards the Republic of San Magnolia. Lena waits to stop them, but...

videos.title: The Truth Is
videos.overview: The team prepares for a final suicide mission against "Morpho," a massive railgun Legion capable of single-handedly turning the tide of the battle.

videos.title: Stay This Way Forever
videos.overview: Nordlicht finds themselves up against a massive foe in the middle of enemy territory, with no hope of escape and no reinforcements coming to help.

videos.title: Together Unto Death
videos.overview: Deep in enemy territory, with supplies running low and damage piling up, Nordlicht makes a final desperate march towards Morpho.

videos.title: All That's Left
videos.overview: The members of Nordlicht drop out one by one in the face of the Legion's onslaught, and Shin is left to face the Morpho alone.

videos.title: Shin
videos.overview: At the end of it all and left behind once more, Shin is at the brink. Just then, someone appears, in a sea of red flowers...

videos.title: Handler One
videos.overview: The operation to destroy the Morpho was a success, and Shin and his team fulfilled their promise to return to the Federacy alive. After enjoying a brief respite, they once again wished to serve in frontline units, but they received a certain notice from Ernst. After crossing the deadly battlefields of the Republic, they arrived at a new meeting in the Federacy. They fight, suffer, and see a ray of hope. This is a story of boys and girls who have begun to move little by little. At the end of their journey, what is reflected in their eyes?
